Mocking One More Prisma Call →

Spying on the Shared Emitter

jest.spyOn keeps the real EventEmitter working while recording every emit() call — assert on what fired, not on what listeners then did.

ticket.service.test.js's existing tests mock config/db.js entirely (Week 2/3) — Prisma never really runs under test. The real domainEvents emitter, though, doesn't need mocking the same way: it's cheap, synchronous to call, and this project's own code (Topic 2), not an external dependency. jest.spyOn wraps it instead of replacing it — .emit() still genuinely runs (so any real listener would still fire), but every call is now also recorded for expect(...) to inspect:

// Figure 5.16: real emitter, spied on rather than replaced (tests/unit/ticket.service.test.js, excerpt)
import domainEvents, { EVENTS } from '../../src/events/emitter.js';

let emitSpy;

beforeEach(() => {
  jest.clearAllMocks();
  emitSpy = jest.spyOn(domainEvents, 'emit');
});

it('updateTicket emits ticket.assigned when a new agent is assigned', async () => {
  const previous = { id: 1, status: 'open', assignedAgentId: null };
  const updated = { id: 1, status: 'open', assignedAgentId: 14 };
  mockPrisma.ticket.update.mockResolvedValue(updated);

  await updateTicket(1, { assignedAgentId: 14 }, previous);

  expect(emitSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(EVENTS.TICKET_ASSIGNED, updated);
});

This test is deliberately narrow: it asserts that updateTicket announced ticket.assigned, with the right payload, not that a Notification row got written or an email got sent — those are notifyInApp.listener.js and notifyEmail.listener.js's own concerns, each already decoupled enough to test separately if this project's suite grew that far. Testing "did the right event fire" here, and nothing about what any listener does with it, is Topic 1's decoupling argument showing up directly in how the tests are even structured. The suite pairs this with three negative cases — re-saving the same agent, un-assigning, and an unrelated field changing — each asserting emitSpy was not called with that event, covering Topic 3's previous-diffing logic from both directions.
